name: eSemnBun
subtitle: Sign with your electronic ID
shortDescription: Sign and verify documents with the Moldovan electronic identity card.
description:
Your electronic ID. Your documents. A straightforward signing workflow.

eSemnBun helps you sign PDFs and other files using the certificate on your Moldovan electronic identity card.

GET STARTED
1. Connect a compatible reader and insert your card.
2. Choose your card and add documents.
3. Approve the signing request and authorize PIN use.
4. Verify the result, then save or share your signed files.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Sign PDFs with PAdES and other files with XAdES.
• Prepare a batch of documents and authorize that batch once.
• Verify signatures and inspect certificate details.
• Use the built-in browser for card signing and login on compatible services.
• Open MSign, EVO, eVMS and MPay from service shortcuts.
• Choose Romanian, English or Russian and a light or dark appearance.
• Manage saved PINs and separately clear browser cache, cookies or history.

REQUIREMENTS
You need an active Moldovan electronic identity card, a valid signing certificate and a compatible card reader. Use an appropriate adapter for your device when needed. NFC is not supported. Internet access is needed for portals, timestamps and online certificate checks.

Your private key stays on the card. An incorrect PIN is never retried automatically. Demo mode lets you explore the interface without hardware; its outputs are not real signatures.

eSemnBun is an independent app. It does not represent the Government of Moldova or public-service operators. Portal availability and authentication methods are controlled by their providers.

promotionalText: Connect your reader, choose your documents and sign with your electronic ID. Verify the result and access compatible services in the built-in browser.

platformNotes.ios: For iPhone and iPad: connect a compatible reader over USB-C or a supported Lightning adapter. Import from Files or the share extension. The built-in browser keeps the app active while signing.
platformNotes.macos: The Mac App Store version uses CryptoTokenKit and App Sandbox. Export results to a chosen location. The external card-insertion helper, vendor-app process control and browser routes accepting arbitrary filesystem paths are not included.
platformNotes.android:
eSemnBun is an independent open-source app by Nicolae Ghimbovschi. It does not represent, and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by the Government of Moldova or any government entity. It is a document-signing tool, not a government service.

OFFICIAL SOURCES
Official sources for signing, authentication, public-service and payment information are linked below. External services are operated by their respective providers; eSemnBun does not issue identity cards or certificates and cannot decide eligibility or guarantee access. Check requirements and current information on the official sites.
MSign — https://msign.gov.md/
MPass — https://mpass.gov.md/
EVO — https://evo.gov.md/
eVMS — https://evms.md/
MPay — https://mpay.gov.md/

For Android phones and tablets: connect a compatible USB reader through OTG, import from the share sheet, and save or share using system controls.
platformNotes.windows: For Windows: connect a compatible reader and add documents by drag-and-drop, the file picker or the eSemnBun Explorer command. Command placement depends on the Windows version and installed package.
